detail.readme:
Simple, secure1 & standards compliant2 web server for the most demanding3 of applications. Read more...


### :zap: Simple performance µWebSockets.js is a standards-compliant web server written in 10,000 lines of C++. It is exposed to Node.js as a simple-to-use, native V8 addon and is 13x faster than Fastify[[4]](https://github.com/uNetworking/uWebSockets.js/releases/tag/v20.71.0), 20x faster than Socket.IO. Since 2022 a fork of µWS has carried Bun to the top of benchmarks, and is responsible for its event-loop, TLS, HTTP, QUIC, WebSockets, pub/sub, and URL routing[[5]](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/main/packages/bun-uws/src)[[6]](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/tree/main/packages/bun-usockets/src). We aren't in the NPM registry but you can easily install it with the NPM client: * `npm install uNetworking/uWebSockets.js#v20.70.0` * Browse the [documentation](https://unetworking.github.io/uWebSockets.js/generated/functions/App.html) and see the [main repo](https://github.com/uNetworking/uWebSockets).
